status.gereedMetVersie: The server can convert documents — LibreOffice {{versie}}.
status.engineOntbreektTitel: Converting is not possible right now
status.engineOntbreekt: The render engine ({{engine}}) is not available on the server. Without LibreOffice no PDF can be produced — report this to the administrator (see DEPLOY.md).
status.fontsOntbrekenTitel: Not all quote fonts are on the server
status.fontsOntbreken: Missing: {{fonts}}. LibreOffice will substitute another font and the PDF layout may shift. Put the font files in backend/fonts/ (see the README there).
status.fontsExtern: With this engine ({{engine}}) the fonts come from the external LibreOffice service; this server cannot tell in advance which fonts are installed there. Put DaxPro, DaxPro-Bold, DaxPro-Light and DaxPro-Medium in that service's image (see DEPLOY.md, route B). After each conversion the result reports which fonts were substituted.

upload.veld: Choose a .docx file or drop it here
upload.hint: Only .docx from the configurator, up to 25 MB. The document is not stored on the server.

resultaat.geenCheckboxen: No checkboxes (☐) were found. The PDF was created, but DocuSign will get no checkbox fields. Check that the document uses the ☐ character or the Wingdings 2 symbol.
resultaat.geschat: For {{aantal}} anchor(s) the box sat in the middle of a text line; its position is estimated. Check those fields in DocuSign.
resultaat.vervangenTekst: LibreOffice did not have {{fonts}} and used another font. The PDF may differ from the Word document. Put the font files on the server (backend/fonts/).
resultaat.apexHint: The PDF carries a hidden anchor per checkbox (\cb_001\, \cb_002\, …) in the text layer. Salesforce Apex turns those into DocuSign fields; the existing anchors (\i1\, \s2\, \n2\, \ref2\) are left untouched.

geschiedenis.uitleg: Every conversion is recorded here: who, when, which file, how many checkboxes and whether a font was substituted. The documents themselves are not stored.
